src: 'position:fixed;left:0;bottom:0;max-height:40vh;overflow:auto;margin:0;color:#ff9090;background:rgba(0,0,0,.8);font:12px monospace;z-index:99;display:none'

k: A test line of dialogue, with *gold* and _italic_ markup.
src: 'A test line of dialogue, with *gold* and _italic_ markup.'

k:
varying vec2 vUv;
    void main() { vUv = uv; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0); }
Lines: a node with nothing to say or do
src: 'Lines: a node with nothing to say or do'

k: Helm
src: 'Helm'

k: The tower's coming down! Everybody out — that includes you, Lord-Commander.
src: 'The tower\'s coming down! Everybody out — that includes you, Lord-Commander.'

k: I'll walk. I'll not be carried out of my own Lantern by a squire.
src: 'I\'ll walk. I\'ll not be carried out of my own Lantern by a squire.'

k: Bram: Knight. Sir Bram Kestrel.
src: 'Bram: Knight. Sir Bram Kestrel.'

k: Garrick: Hm. And who dubbed you?
src: 'Garrick: Hm. And who dubbed you?'

k: Bram: A deserter.
src: 'Bram: A deserter.'

k: Garrick: Ha. Of course he did.
src: 'Garrick: Ha. Of course he did.'

k: Bram: Then walk.
src: 'Bram: Then walk.'

k: The Grand Lantern. Bram fought Garrick alone. He went down twice and got up twice. He didn't kill him. Garrick gave us the Shard and walked out on his own. Bram's hands didn't stop shaking for an hour. He says that's the trick.
src: 'The Grand Lantern. Bram fought Garrick alone. He went down twice and got up twice. He didn\'t kill him. Garrick gave us the Shard and walked out on his own. Bram\'s hands didn\'t stop shaking for an hour. He says that\'s the trick.'

k: Pressed between two volumes of liturgy: a child's drawing. Two stick figures under an enormous yellow sun. The tall one is labeled CASS. The small one is labeled ME.
src: 'Pressed between two volumes of liturgy: a child\'s drawing. Two stick figures under an enormous yellow sun. The tall one is labeled CASS. The small one is labeled ME.'

k: Underneath, in a grown man's careful hand: _Lysa, age 7._
src: 'Underneath, in a grown man\'s careful hand: _Lysa, age 7._'

k: ...She drew the sun too big.
src: '...She drew the sun too big.'

k: Everybody draws the sun too big when they're seven.
src: 'Everybody draws the sun too big when they\'re seven.'

k: A Choir ledger. Columns of names from the Undercroft, each with a date and a single word beside it: _Offered._ At the foot of every page, the same initials, in the same careful hand as the drawing: C.L.
src: 'A Choir ledger. Columns of names from the Undercroft, each with a date and a single word beside it: _Offered._ At the foot of every page, the same initials, in the same careful hand as the drawing: C.L.'

k: He knew. About Mercy. About the Undercroft. He signed every page.
src: 'He knew. About Mercy. About the Undercroft. He signed every page.'

k: He dismissed her in front of the whole city.
src: 'He dismissed her in front of the whole city.'

k: He's always very kind in front of people.
src: 'He\'s always very kind in front of people.'

k: The Halcyon moors at the end of the old dock. The dock hangs over nothing now.
src: 'The Halcyon moors at the end of the old dock. The dock hangs over nothing now.'

k: This is where she stood. This is where she gave you Dad's compass, and told you to go.
src: 'This is where she stood. This is where she gave you Dad\'s compass, and told you to go.'

k: ...I came back. I'm late.
src: '...I came back. I\'m late.'

k: That was not her. That was the island remembering her.
src: 'That was not her. That was the island remembering her.'

k: The whole island is doing it. Look. The square. The well.
src: 'The whole island is doing it. Look. The square. The well.'

k: The Lantern's still burning. Up on the bluff.
src: 'The Lantern\'s still burning. Up on the bluff.'

k: She's up there.
src: 'She\'s up there.'

k: Then we walk up. Nobody's in a hurry, sparrow. Not here.
src: 'Then we walk up. Nobody\'s in a hurry, sparrow. Not here.'

k: Lanternfall. The dock hangs over nothing. The island is remembering things. It remembered Mom saying "come back to me." I did. A year late.
src: 'Lanternfall. The dock hangs over nothing. The island is remembering things. It remembered Mom saying "come back to me." I did. A year late.'

k: Up on the bluff, the light in the Lantern's doorway thins, like a held breath let out.
src: 'Up on the bluff, the light in the Lantern\'s doorway thins, like a held breath let out.'

k: The village well. WREN + ILSE + THE SEA. The W is backwards. It always was.
src: 'The village well. WREN + ILSE + THE SEA. The W is backwards. It always was.'

k: Little Ilse
src: 'Little Ilse'

k: You did the W backwards.
src: 'You did the W backwards.'

k: Little Wren
src: 'Little Wren'

k: It's _stylish_. When I'm famous everyone'll do their W's like this.
src: 'It\'s _stylish_. When I\'m famous everyone\'ll do their W\'s like this.'

k: You're not going to be famous. You're going to be a Keeper like your mum.
src: 'You\'re not going to be famous. You\'re going to be a Keeper like your mum.'

k: I'm going to sail to the end of the world and come back with a sea monster.
src: 'I\'m going to sail to the end of the world and come back with a sea monster.'

k: ...Can I come?
src: '...Can I come?'

k: Obviously. Somebody has to carry the bandages.
src: 'Obviously. Somebody has to carry the bandages.'

k: We were seven.
src: 'We were seven.'

k: I did come back with a sea monster. Sort of. Brinefang counts.
src: 'I did come back with a sea monster. Sort of. Brinefang counts.'

k: It doesn't count, you didn't bring it back.
src: 'It doesn\'t count, you didn\'t bring it back.'

k: The memory sours at the edges, the way milk turns — and the well vomits up black water, and the water has hands.
src: 'The memory sours at the edges, the way milk turns — and the well vomits up black water, and the water has hands.'

k: For the record, I still have the bandages.
src: 'For the record, I still have the bandages.'

k: Home. The east wall is gone; the sky looks in. Everything else is exactly where it was. Two plates on the table.
src: 'Home. The east wall is gone; the sky looks in. Everything else is exactly where it was. Two plates on the table.'

k: Because the last Halloway who sailed east never came back!
src: 'Because the last Halloway who sailed east never came back!'

k: ...Dad would have let me go.
src: '...Dad would have let me go.'

k: Your father would have gone _with_ you.
src: 'Your father would have gone _with_ you.'

k: I left the table. I didn't even finish supper. That was the last supper we ever had, and I didn't finish it.
src: 'I left the table. I didn\'t even finish supper. That was the last supper we ever had, and I didn\'t finish it.'

k: Outside, something is scratching at the door. Something that came up out of the sea on a stormy night, a long time ago, and never really left.
src: 'Outside, something is scratching at the door. Something that came up out of the sea on a stormy night, a long time ago, and never really left.'

k: Two plates. She kept setting two plates. For seven years. Even after Dad.
src: 'Two plates. She kept setting two plates. For seven years. Even after Dad.'

k: No. Not for Dad. For me. One for her and one for me.
src: 'No. Not for Dad. For me. One for her and one for me.'
